title: Source
description: One entry in the source registry. Records how access is obtained, never a secret.

rank.description: Overrides the default rank of the source kind; lower wins.

adapter.description: The adapter that reads this source (entry point group factmodel.adapters).

engine.description: For a warehouse, the engine slug used in pins (free slug).

dialect.description: The sqlglot dialect; required when the engine has no default dialect.

dsn_env.description: The environment variable that holds the connection string. Never the string.

revision.description: For a git source, the commit, branch or tag to read; worktree reads files as they are.

include.description: For a git source, path globs of the files to parse (for example DDL).

current_pin.description: The version of the source as last read; evidence pinned elsewhere is stale.

access.description: How access is obtained. Never a secret.

extensions.description: A free map for adopters; never read by the core.

pin.description: The exact version read; the format depends on the source kind.
